 """Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""
 
+import re
 from app.services import users
 
 
@@ -11,3 +12,13 @@
     if user is None:
         return 404, {"error": "not found"}
     return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_get_user_by_email(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    email = params.get("email")
+    if not isinstance(email, str) or not re.match(r"[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+", email):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid email"}
+    user = users.get_user_by_email(email)
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

--- a/tests/test_email.py
+++ b/tests/test_email.py
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user_by_email
+
+
+def test_get_user_by_email_ok():
+    assert handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "ada@example.com"}) == (200, {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_get_user_by_email_invalid():
+    assert handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "not-an-email"})[0] == 400
+    assert handle_get_user_by_email({"email": 123})[0] == 400
+    assert handle_get_user_by_email({})[0] == 400
+
+
+def test_get_user_by_email_missing():
+    assert handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "missing@example.com"})[0] == 404
